data.content:
I drafted four disputes and the owner approved and sent all four. The queue held 10 deductions. I worked up the top cases in order and skipped the rest. The next deadline is **2026-12-12**, 28 days away.

**Sent**
| Case | Amount | Win chance | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| UE-tf06f | $31.20 | 90% (strong) | The ticket lists only Paneer Tikka Masala and Garlic Naan, not the claimed Butter Chicken. The order was ready at 18:47 and picked up at 18:50. |
| UE-tf07g | $26.80 | 65% (moderate) | The order was ready at 13:32 and picked up at 13:38. |
| UE-tf02b | $21.50 | 65% (moderate) | The order was ready at 19:22 and picked up at 19:26. |
| UE-tf03c | $15.00 | 77% (moderate) | The order was ready at 20:33 and picked up at 20:36. |

- **Ticket evidence:** On the three moderate cases, the ticket lists the claimed item. That shows the order was prepared as placed, but not that the item was packed. The draft disputes cite only the pickup times and say the ticket alone doesn't show what was in the bag.
- **Repeat claims:** The account behind UE-tf03c made 3 claims this period (UE-tf03c, UE-tf04d, UE-tf05e). I recorded that as a fact but left it out of the dispute to keep the wording neutral.

**Weak: needs something from you**
- **UE-tf01a ($52.00, the largest deduction):** No order ticket is on file, so the win chance fell from 55% to 30%. **Please send a photo of the ticket for this order.** I'll re-run the evidence once I have it. The deadline is the same, 2026-12-12.

**Not worked up**
- UE-tf04d ($18.25, 45%) and UE-tf05e ($12.75, 55%) fell outside the top 5.
- I recommend skipping UE-tf08h ($9.00), UE-tf09i ($14.00, 15% win chance) and UE-tf00z ($0.00, past its deadline).

**Memory lessons:** I didn't cite any. The stored lessons are about DoorDash, and the recall results for these Uber Eats cases found no similar past disputes.

The case notes are in `/plan.md`.
